sources.title: Before the Story Decides
sources.author: Ricky Jones
sources.support: Distinguishes evidence and entitlement to act; acting with incomplete information; no obligation to tolerate harm.
sources.not_support: Neuroscience, implementation results, influence by FAZON

sources.title: Zero Trust Architecture
sources.author: NIST / Rose et al.
sources.basis: Official NIST SP 800-207 final PDF re-read 2026-10-05, sections 2.1 and 3
sources.support: Per-session resource access; dynamic policy; continual monitoring with possible reauthentication/reauthorization; policy engine grant/deny/revoke; decision/enforcement roles.
sources.not_support: FAZON novelty, episode schema endorsement, mandatory live network query for every action

sources.title: Remote ATtestation procedureS (RATS) Architecture
sources.author: IETF / Birkholz et al.
sources.support: Evidence vs appraisal result vs reliance; freshness policy; race condition and bounded reuse.
sources.not_support: Identity with FAZON post-action attestation or assurance of target consequences

sources.title: Verified Episode v0.2 / public replies

sources.support: Author says contributions will be folded into v0.2 and credited; archive appears in commit.
sources.not_support: Independent verification of internal content/tests, implementation equivalence, endorsement of FAZON

sources.author: Alexander Wolfgang Strüver
sources.support: Methodological evidence separation and author distinction physical admissibility vs normative permission.

sources.title: Λ — Decision Boundary
sources.author: Hiro Yokoki
sources.basis: Owner-pasted LinkedIn article plus IMG_5851 public reply screenshot
sources.support: Selection/authorization/enforcement distinction; author reply says authorization-execution binding essential, EXECUTE verdict alone insufficient, and describes an episode-bound decision object consumed by enforcement before side effects; post-execution trace separate.
sources.not_support: Completed implementation, independent verification, technical equivalence with FAZON, verified DOI record.
